controls.random: Newborn neural weights reinitialized from deterministic seed and id, no neural inheritance
controls.clone: Offspring get exact parental neural weights; heritable selection without mutation
controls.evolve: Offspring inherit mutated weights; current AI1
controls.targeted: Count of prey selected by red during red hunting acquisition; NOT a strict unique chase outcome
controls.escapeProxy: 1 - hunt deaths / targeted; not a confirmed successful escape rate
controls.exposure: Green individual-days with a visible red predator within AI danger range
controls.cohort: Generation zero, one-two, three-five, or six and higher; nonrandom survivor/censoring bias
